summary: No installer-harm signals observed in ts-vitest@1.0.8
details: Package ts-vitest@1.0.8 was scanned across 23 files with no a static rule matches and no traced behaviors indicating credential access, exfiltration, install-time remote code fetch, silent relay, dropper, backdoor, or self-propagation. The package name resembles the popular vitest test runner, which is worth noting as a potential typosquat vector, but name resemblance alone is not a threat class under this system's rules and no malicious behavior is present in the code to justify an escalation.
